mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as day, SUM(amount) as dailyTotal FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND order_time >= #{startTime} AND order_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY day ORDER BY day ASC

SELECT CASE WHEN HOUR(o.order_time) BETWEEN 5 AND 10 THEN '早餐' WHEN HOUR(o.order_time) BETWEEN 11 AND 15 THEN '午餐' ELSE '晚餐' END as mealPeriod, COUNT(*) as percentage FROM orders o JOIN order_detail od ON o.id = od.order_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.order_time >= #{startTime} AND o.order_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY mealPeriod

SELECT od.name as dishName, SUM(od.amount) as totalSpend FROM order_detail od JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.order_time >= #{startTime} AND o.order_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY od.name ORDER BY totalSpend DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT od.name as dishName, SUM(od.number) as totalCount FROM order_detail od JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.order_time >= #{startTime} AND o.order_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY od.name ORDER BY totalCount DESC LIMIT 1
